blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Far Eastern University-DN Steel turned to unsung heroes Charles Absin and setter Rhodson Du-ot to deal ClearSkiiin’s first defeat, 27-29, 25-19, 25-22, 25-21, in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Sunday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Absin snapped the Tamaraws’ two-game skid with 23 points off 17 attacks, five kill blocks, and an ace to put an end to ClearSkiiin’s four-game unbeaten run. “We started working on it during training. We made sure to put in the effort during practice so we could carry that momentum into the game. Hopefully, we can sustain this […]...
